purpose: resolve user-reported problems that first-line support cannot, using logs, runbooks and safe diagnosis, and escalate correctly
entry_criteria: A ticket is escalated from first-line support with steps and impact
Runbooks and read access to logs and dashboards exist
Escalation path to engineering is defined
procedure: Confirm the impact, the affected users and the severity; raise severity if many users are affected.
Reproduce or find the failing request in logs using the ticket's identifiers.
Check the known-issue list and recent changes for a match and apply the runbook fix if one exists.
If there is no known fix, collect the evidence engineering needs and escalate to L3 with it.
Update the customer at the agreed intervals in plain language.
Record the cause and fix, and add or improve the runbook entry.
acceptance_criteria: Escalation includes identifiers, logs and reproduction steps
Customer was updated at the agreed intervals
Runbook was updated for new fixes
validation_method: Support lead review of the resolution record.

validation.check: confirm the escalation ticket contains request identifiers, timestamps and log excerpts
check the time between updates to the customer against the target

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A customer's invoices fail to download. Logs show a timeout on one large account. The runbook step to regenerate the file works; the cause is escalated to L3 with the request id, and the customer is updated.
